messages:
tara: Kicking off a quick thread for the Quickstart/onboarding refresh. Scope: single-file hello-world (JS + Python), browser PKCE flow, minimal server-side API-key rotation note, tiny Docker local dev, and a GitHub Actions 'first deploy' example. I'll open a draft PR tonight. cc @emily @ben

emily: Love it. Can we keep code samples extremely short and runnable (install + minimal run command)? Also include a curl token check that folks can use to debug 401s.

ben: Agreed. For the JS examples use the named Client import and show PKCE start + callback in three lines. For server example use the new python package `redwood_inference.Client` and demonstrate a basic generate call.

arthur: I'll audit the sidebar links tomorrow. I found a stale nav link to /getting-started/old-quickstart that still exists; we should redirect it and surface a migration note for Dedicated customers (REDWOOD_HOST + KMS).

tara: Good catch. I'll add a redirect and a short migration blurb. Also planning a tiny Docker Compose that serves a static index.html and sets REDWOOD_HOST for local Dedicated testing (optional section).

emily: JS snippet suggestion (keep as copy-paste):
```js
import { Client } from '@redwood/inference-js';
const client = new Client({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
// start PKCE
await client.auth.login({ flow: 'pkce', redirectUri: 'http://localhost:5173/auth/callback' });
const r = await client.generate('Hi from quickstart');
console.log(r.text);
```

ben: Python server snippet (very short):
```py
from redwood_inference import Client
client = Client(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_API_KEY'))
print(client.generate('Hello quickstart').text)
```

tara: I'll include both and target package v0.11 in examples. Also adding a 1-line curl debug: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"input":"test"}'`

emily: Add a Troubleshooting accordion with: 401 -> check key + scopes; CORS -> add origin in console; redirect mismatch -> exact-URI check. One-liners are fine.

ben: For Dedicated ops note: "Set REDWOOD_HOST to your private control plane and ensure KMS is configured. Rotate API keys regularly (example cron in ops guide)." I'll draft that blurb.

tara: Also adding a tiny GitHub Actions job that runs `npm ci && npm run build` and a short step to lint docs so we catch missing envs. Will mark as optional in the quickstart.
